caption: The video captures a nighttime fireworks display over a calm dark lake, with town lights on the left horizon and bursts mirrored below. Two large dome-shaped bursts of pink, white, and green streaks hang near center, their reflections stretching downward as sparks droop and dim. A thin vertical trail stays on the right, while nearby trails form small palm-shaped orange-white bursts that spread and fade. Higher up, several spherical bursts bloom into colored rings and bright cores, expanding across the upper sky with blue, green, and orange light. A red glow strengthens at the left edge of the launch line near the horizon, casting a red streak into the water's reflection. The lake mirror tracks the changing sky, shifting from fading central domes to brighter, more colorful high bursts. The camera remains fixed on the shoreline as the display continues.
relations: Expanding dome streaks droop and dim -> their lake reflections stretch downward and fade in sync.
Higher spherical bursts bloom into colored rings -> the mirror shifts from fading domes to brighter high colors.
Red glow strengthens at left horizon -> a matching red streak appears in the water's reflection.
Camera fixed on shoreline -> burst positions stay centered while sparks spread, trail remains vertical on right.
